items.title: Cisco raises AI outlook as infrastructure demand accelerates
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi welcomes Cisco (CSCO) CFO Mark Patterson to discuss the company’s latest earnings, investor concerns, and Cisco’s updated full-year AI outlook. Cisco is forecasting continued strength in AI infrastructure demand, with FY2027 AI infrastructure revenue expected to reach $7.5 billion.

items.title: Citi seals deal to buy reward platform Kard Financial
items.summary: Kard links merchants and financial institutions through verified transaction data and merchant-funded rewards.

items.title: Should you chase this mini rally in gold? Citi weighs in
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi believes the backdrop for gold is improving as U.S. front-end rates roll over, but the bank said in a note on Friday that it is holding off on adding exposure after a rapid run higher.

items.title: Are KOSPI and SOX in a bubble? Citi answers
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi told clients in a note on Friday that investor attention around asset bubbles has moved away from U.S. large-cap benchmarks and toward chipmakers and South Korean stocks.

items.title: China’s Credit Growth Exceeds Forecasts Despite Rare Loan Slump
items.summary: China’s credit expansion held up better than expected in July, but weak borrowing demand among households and businesses pushed loans into a worse-than-forecast contraction.

items.title: Citi Strikes Rare Acquisition With Rewards Startup Kard
items.summary: Citi will work with the start-up on ways to deliver more personalized experiences. Terms of the transaction weren’t disclosed.
